newsitem.title: UK: EU seen awarding up to 110,000 T sugar at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU seen awarding up to 110,000 T sugar at tender.

text.p: The European Union (EU) is expected to award up to 110,000 tonnes of current series white sugar at its weekly tender later on Wednesday, traders said.
Another large tonnage was expected this week, with estimates ranging between 80,000 and 110,000 tonnes after the EU awarded 104,350 tonnes in its last tender on November 6.
Traders noted heavy hedge selling in the futures market during Tuesday's session and said favourable currency rates were likely to encourage a high number of licence bids.
The EU was also lagging in its licence tonnage programme, they said.
"There is still a bit of catching up to do before we even get back to last year's situation," said one.
The maximum restitution for licences this week was forecast at 47.098 Ecus (European Currency Units) per 100 kg of sugar, based on the Paris March white sugar contract.
The EU restitution was 46.721 Ecus last week.
